getting_started.card.blame.body: Blame shows the commit behind every line of a file.
getting_started.card.blame.title: Who changed this line
getting_started.card.commands.body: Add your own Git or shell commands to the palette and the menus.
getting_started.card.commands.title: Custom commands
getting_started.card.connect.body: Sign in to see pull requests, checks and issues next to your branches.
getting_started.card.connect.title: Connect a hosting service
getting_started.card.dashboard.body: Pull requests and issues from all your repositories on one page.
getting_started.card.dashboard.title: Dashboard
getting_started.card.journal.body: Glowfly records every change it makes, and the operation journal can undo most of them.
getting_started.card.journal.title: Undo with the journal
getting_started.card.keys.body: Change any shortcut, or add keys for the commands you use most.
getting_started.card.keys.title: Keyboard shortcuts
getting_started.card.palette.body: Type a few letters of any command to find it and run it.
getting_started.card.palette.title: Command palette
getting_started.card.rebase.body: Select a commit in the graph to rewrite it, or to rebase onto it.
getting_started.card.rebase.title: Reword, squash or drop commits
getting_started.card.stash.body: Put unfinished changes aside, switch tasks, and bring them back later.
getting_started.card.stash.title: Stash
getting_started.card.terminal.body: A shell in the repository's folder, right under the graph.
getting_started.card.terminal.title: Built-in terminal
getting_started.card.theme.body: Pick light, dark or high contrast, or make a theme of your own.
getting_started.card.theme.title: Themes
getting_started.card.tools.body: Open files in your editor, and compare and merge in your own tools.
getting_started.card.tools.title: Your editor and tools
getting_started.card.tour.body: Five stops around the main window, from the toolbar to the command palette.
getting_started.card.tour.title: Take the tour
getting_started.card.worktrees.body: Check out another branch in a folder of its own and keep both open as tabs.
getting_started.card.worktrees.title: Worktrees
getting_started.hidden.toast: Getting started is hidden from the Help menu. The command palette still finds it.
getting_started.intro: A few things Glowfly can do for you. Each card opens its feature so you can try it.
getting_started.needs_changes: Change a file first: there is nothing to stash yet.
getting_started.needs_commit: Select a commit in the graph first.
getting_started.needs_view_closed: Close the conflict, rebase, history or blame view first.
getting_started.show_finished.check: Show the cards already in use ({n})
getting_started.shown.toast: Getting started is back in the Help menu.
getting_started.title: Getting started
